title: British investor Baillie Gifford fund marks down Dailyhunt parent amid revenue pressures
summary: British investor Baillie Gifford fund marks down Dailyhunt parent amid revenue pressures
detailed: The Schiehallion Fund pegged the fair value of its 1.3% holding in VerSe Innovation at $7.47 million, according to its portfolio disclosures reviewed by ET, implying a total company valuation of roughly $576 million.
